p='programs/task-a3198f0b.py'
s='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Full-width or full-height monochrome lines separate repeated regions.
    for axis in (0, 1):
        n = h if axis == 0 else w
        m = w if axis == 0 else h
        lines = []
        for i in range(n):
            vals = [grid[i][j] for j in range(m)] if axis == 0 else [grid[j][i] for j in range(m)]
            if vals and len(set(vals)) == 1 and vals[0] != bg:
                lines.append(i)
        if not lines:
            continue
        bounds = [-1] + lines + [n]
        regions = [(bounds[k] + 1, bounds[k + 1]) for k in range(len(bounds) - 1)]
        regions = [region for region in regions if region[1] > region[0]]
        if len(regions) < 2 or len({b - a for a, b in regions}) != 1:
            continue
        for p in range(regions[0][1] - regions[0][0]):
            for q in range(m):
                marks = []
                for a, _ in regions:
                    value = grid[a + p][q] if axis == 0 else grid[q][a + p]
                    if value != bg:
                        marks.append(value)
                if not marks:
                    continue
                value = marks[0]
                for a, _ in regions:
                    if axis == 0:
                        if out[a + p][q] == bg:
                            out[a + p][q] = value
                    elif out[q][a + p] == bg:
                        out[q][a + p] = value
    return out
'''
